entries.description: Agent-to-Agent card for Bangladesh multi-hazard early warning: flash flood, tropical cyclone, drought, cold wave, fire and severe local storm outlooks, live alerts, weather observations and the historical event catalogue.
representativeQueries: what is the flash flood risk in Sylhet over the next five days
are there any active tropical cyclone alerts for the Bangladesh coast
give me the drought outlook for the northwestern districts
list historical flood events in Sunamganj

entries.description: Model Context Protocol server card exposing eight hazard tools for forecasts, live alerts, current weather, the historical event catalogue, district profiles, advisory chat and unit conversion.
representativeQueries: get the hazard forecast for Habiganj district
what alerts are currently active in Bangladesh
what is the weather right now in Cox's Bazar
convert 250 millimetres of rainfall to inches

entries.description: Browser-side tools registered at runtime through document.modelContext.registerTool() on https://www.hazardnet.live. Published inline as `data` rather than by `url` because WebMCP tools live in the page's JavaScript and have no separate fetchable descriptor; the DNS-AID record _webmcp._agents.hazardnet.live still advertises the transport.
representativeQueries: search for a district on this page
show me the hazard forecast for the district I am viewing
take me to the live alerts page

entries.description: RFC 9727 linkset catalog for the HazardNet REST API, carrying service-desc (OpenAPI), service-doc and status link relations for each API base URL.
representativeQueries: where is the HazardNet API documentation
what is the health status endpoint for the HazardNet API

entries.description: OpenAPI description of the HazardNet REST API: forecast, alert, weather and historical-catalogue endpoints.
representativeQueries: what endpoints does the HazardNet API expose
how do I call the hazard forecast endpoint

entries.description: Cloudflare Agent Skills Discovery v0.2.0 index of the SKILL.md documents this site publishes, each with a sha256 digest, covering A2A cards, MCP, RFC 9727 API catalogs, auth.md, OAuth discovery, DNS-AID and content signals.
representativeQueries: what agent skills does hazardnet.live publish
how do I publish an A2A agent card

entries.description: Agent registration and authentication metadata for the HazardNet APIs: how to obtain credentials and which endpoints accept anonymous access. Plain text/markdown, not the agent-skills profile.
representativeQueries: how do I authenticate against the HazardNet API
which HazardNet endpoints allow anonymous access
